item.description:
• Defer calling updater.checkForUpdates() from SparkleUpdaterDelegate.updater(_:didFindValidUpdate:) until updater(_:didFinishUpdateCycleFor:error:) so Sparkle's SPUProbingUpdateDriver has finished and cleared sessionInProgress before presenting the interactive update sheet.
  • Wait for canCheckForUpdates && !sessionInProgress on DispatchQueue.main in AppUpdaterModel.mainWindowDidAppear() so checkForUpdatesOnLaunch() neither preempts SPUUpdater.startUpdater()'s async startup turn nor fires mid-session during Sparkle's scheduled 24-hour background check.
  • Mark didCheckOnLaunch = true when Sparkle's scheduled check already shows an update or when the user manually triggers Check for Updates…, and add GatteyPhotosAppTests unit coverage.
